title: Round scaled values inside theme files

target.summary: The `EDSCALE_RND` macro does not wrap `m_value` in parentheses. When invoked with an expression such as addition, operator precedence causes only the last operand to be multiplied by `EDSCALE`, resulting in incorrect theme scaling calculations.
notes: faulty macro definition missing parentheses around argument
call site passing an expression that exposes the macro operator precedence bug
